categories.title: Secrets & Credentials
categories.description: Indexed credentials, private keys, tokens, connection strings, and secret-bearing configuration.

dorks.title: Environment files with credential markers
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:env OR ext:ini OR ext:cfg) ("DB_PASSWORD" OR "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" OR "API_KEY")
dorks.description: Finds indexed environment and INI-style files that contain database, cloud, or API credential markers.

dorks.title: Target references in dotenv files
dorks.description: Finds public dotenv variants referencing the target; these often contain deployment credentials and internal endpoints.

dorks.title: GitLab dotenv exposure
dorks.description: Searches GitLab indexed blobs for target references in dotenv files, which may expose credentials or internal configuration.

dorks.title: Sourcegraph dotenv variants
dorks.description: Finds target references in dotenv files across Sourcegraph-indexed repositories for cross-host secret discovery.

dorks.title: AWS credential variables
dorks.description: Finds target-related code or configuration containing AWS access-key variable names and possible live cloud credentials.

dorks.title: AWS variables near target strings
dorks.description: Regex-searches public code for target identifiers on the same line as AWS credential variables.

dorks.title: AWS access-key identifiers
dorks.description: Finds long-lived AWS access-key ID patterns in target-related public code; validate ownership and exposure without using the secret.

dorks.title: PEM and OpenSSH private keys
dorks.query: "{T}" ("-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----" OR "-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----" OR "-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----")
dorks.description: Finds private-key blocks committed with target references, potentially enabling server, signing, or service impersonation.

dorks.title: Indexed private-key containers
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:pem OR ext:key OR ext:p12 OR ext:pfx)
dorks.description: Finds indexed PEM, key, PKCS#12, and PFX files that may contain private keys or certificates.

dorks.title: SSH private-key filenames
dorks.query: "{T}" (path:id_rsa OR path:id_dsa OR path:id_ed25519 OR path:*.ppk)
dorks.description: Finds commonly named SSH private-key files associated with the target in public repositories.

dorks.title: Source-control access tokens
dorks.description: Finds GitHub and GitLab token prefixes near target identifiers; leaked tokens can expose private repositories and CI data.

dorks.title: Chat and webhook secrets
dorks.description: Finds Slack tokens, Slack webhook URLs, and Discord webhooks that can leak messages or permit unauthorized posting.

dorks.title: AI provider API credentials
dorks.description: Finds target-related OpenAI and Anthropic credential material that could expose models, data, or billable quota.

dorks.title: AI secrets near target identifiers
dorks.description: Finds AI-provider secret variables near target strings using grep.app's RE2 search.

dorks.title: Stripe live secret keys
dorks.description: Finds live Stripe secret or restricted-key material associated with the target, with potential payment and customer-data impact.

dorks.title: Database connection URLs
dorks.description: Finds database URLs that may embed usernames, passwords, internal hosts, and database names.

dorks.title: Indexed connection-string configuration
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:config OR ext:json OR ext:yaml OR ext:yml) ("connectionString" OR "jdbc:" OR "mongodb+srv://")
dorks.description: Finds indexed application configuration with database connection strings and possible embedded credentials.

dorks.title: Google service-account JSON
dorks.description: Finds GCP service-account JSON containing private-key fields, which can grant cloud API access.

dorks.title: Container registry authentication
dorks.description: Finds Docker and OCI registry authentication configuration with base64 credentials or identity tokens.

dorks.title: Package-registry credentials
dorks.description: Finds npm and Python package registry credentials capable of package theft or supply-chain publication.

dorks.title: Kubernetes client credentials
dorks.description: Finds kubeconfig client key and certificate data that may provide direct cluster access.

dorks.title: CI workflow credential usage
dorks.query: "{T}" (path:.github/workflows OR path:.gitlab-ci.yml OR path:.circleci) (AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY OR PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN OR CLIENT_SECRET)
dorks.description: Finds CI definitions with sensitive credential variables, unsafe logging, or deployment secrets requiring review.

dorks.title: JWT secrets and token material
dorks.description: Finds indexed JWT signing-secret variables and encoded token material associated with the target.

dorks.title: Credentials leaked in URLs
dorks.description: Finds indexed URLs containing credential parameters, which also leak through logs, history, and Referer headers.

dorks.title: Credential parameters in scanned URLs
dorks.query: domain:{T} AND (filename:access_token OR filename:api_key OR filename:apikey)
dorks.description: Finds archived urlscan requests involving the target with token or API-key parameter names.

dorks.title: Archived dotenv files
dorks.description: Finds historical dotenv captures across target subdomains; deleted files can remain recoverable in archives.

dorks.title: Secrets in indexed page source
dorks.description: Searches indexed HTML, JavaScript, and CSS for target references near common client-side secret names.

dorks.title: Credential helper and password files
dorks.query: "{T}" (path:.git-credentials OR path:.netrc OR path:.pgpass OR path:.htpasswd)
dorks.description: Finds credential-helper, netrc, PostgreSQL, and htpasswd files containing reusable plaintext or hashed credentials.

categories.title: Cloud Storage & Infrastructure

dorks.title: Amazon S3 buckets referencing target

dorks.title: Regional and dual-stack S3 endpoints

dorks.title: Google Cloud Storage objects
dorks.description: Finds GCS buckets and publicly indexed objects tied to the target for anonymous listing and data-exposure review.

dorks.title: Azure Blob Storage objects
dorks.description: Finds public Azure Blob containers and files associated with the target.

dorks.title: DigitalOcean Spaces objects
dorks.description: Finds target-related Spaces buckets and indexed objects that may allow public listing or download.

dorks.title: Firebase Realtime Database endpoints
dorks.description: Finds target-related Firebase RTDB hosts for subsequent authorization and public JSON-access review.

dorks.title: Google Cloud Storage browser links
dorks.description: Finds cloud-console-style GCS object links that can reveal bucket names and object paths even when direct objects are not indexed.

dorks.title: Azure Files shares
dorks.description: Finds indexed Azure Files share URLs associated with the target, which may disclose documents or backup data.

dorks.title: CloudFront distributions
dorks.description: Finds target-related CloudFront distributions and cached objects, useful for identifying shadow assets and origin clues.

dorks.title: Unencrypted Docker API
dorks.description: Finds target hosts exposing the unencrypted Docker API, which can permit full container and host control if unauthenticated.

dorks.title: Kubernetes API servers
dorks.description: Finds Kubernetes API endpoints on target hosts for anonymous-auth and exposed-control-plane review.

dorks.title: etcd client endpoints
dorks.description: Finds etcd services that may expose cluster state and Kubernetes secrets when accessible without authentication.

dorks.title: Docker API on certificate-related hosts
dorks.description: Finds Docker API services on hosts presenting target-related certificates using current Censys CenQL.

dorks.title: Kubernetes API and kubelet exposure
dorks.description: Finds target-domain Kubernetes API and kubelet ports for authentication and pod-exposure review.

dorks.title: Docker API on ZoomEye
dorks.description: Finds target-related unencrypted Docker API services through ZoomEye's independent scan coverage.

dorks.title: Terraform state with cloud secrets
dorks.query: "{T}" (path:terraform.tfstate OR path:*.tfstate) (access_key OR secret_key OR password)
dorks.description: Finds Terraform state files, which often contain cloud credentials, database passwords, resource IDs, and internal topology.

dorks.title: AWS CLI credential files
dorks.query: "{T}" (path:.s3cfg OR path:credentials OR path:.aws) (aws_access_key_id OR aws_secret_access_key)
dorks.description: Finds AWS CLI and s3cmd credential files associated with target infrastructure.

dorks.title: Redis exposure on target-related records
dorks.description: Finds Redis services in BinaryEdge records containing the target identifier, for unauthenticated data-access review.

dorks.title: phpMyAdmin interfaces

dorks.title: Grafana dashboards

dorks.title: Kibana consoles

dorks.title: Splunk web interfaces

dorks.title: Grafana via Shodan titles

dorks.title: phpMyAdmin via Shodan titles
dorks.description: Finds target-hosted phpMyAdmin interfaces from service-scan titles.

dorks.title: Grafana fingerprint on FOFA
dorks.description: Finds target-domain assets fingerprinted as Grafana by FOFA.

dorks.title: Kibana titles on Censys
dorks.description: Finds Kibana web endpoints on target hostnames using Censys web-property data.

dorks.title: Splunk fingerprint on ZoomEye
dorks.description: Finds target-related Splunk services in ZoomEye's application fingerprint index.

dorks.title: Prometheus and metrics consoles
dorks.query: site:{T} (intitle:"Prometheus Time Series Collection and Processing Server" OR inurl:prometheus)
dorks.description: Finds Prometheus interfaces and metrics endpoints that can reveal internal services, labels, and infrastructure metadata.

dorks.title: RabbitMQ management consoles
dorks.description: Finds RabbitMQ management pages that may expose queues, messages, users, and cluster metadata.

dorks.title: RabbitMQ management port
dorks.description: Finds target hosts exposing RabbitMQ's management service on its standard port.

dorks.title: WebLogic administration services
dorks.description: Finds WebLogic services on target hosts for console exposure and version-specific vulnerability review.

dorks.title: Tomcat Web Application Manager
dorks.description: Finds Tomcat manager consoles that can permit application deployment when authentication is weak or absent.

dorks.title: cPanel and Webmin portals
dorks.description: Finds hosting and Unix administration portals that expose high-privilege authentication surface.

categories.title: Version-Control Exposure
categories.description: Exposed repository metadata that can disclose source code, history, branches, remotes, and credentials.

dorks.title: Exposed Git configuration
dorks.description: Finds served .git/config files with repository metadata and remote URLs; a downloadable repository may follow.

dorks.title: Exposed Git HEAD
dorks.description: Finds .git/HEAD responses that reveal branch names and confirm repository metadata exposure.

dorks.title: Directory-listed Git repositories
dorks.description: Finds autoindexed .git directories that may allow recursive repository reconstruction.

dorks.title: Subversion entries metadata
dorks.description: Finds exposed Subversion metadata that can disclose repository structure and versioned source files.

dorks.title: CVS Entries metadata
dorks.description: Finds exposed CVS bookkeeping files that reveal filenames, revisions, and repository layout.

dorks.title: Mercurial repository configuration
dorks.description: Finds Mercurial configuration files with paths, credentials, and repository metadata.

dorks.title: Bazaar branch metadata
dorks.description: Finds exposed Bazaar branch metadata indicating reconstructable version-control content.

dorks.title: Git metadata in urlscan requests
dorks.description: Finds archived target pages that requested .git paths, confirming historically observable repository probes or references.

dorks.title: Archived Git repository metadata
dorks.description: Finds historical captures of target .git metadata, useful when current exposure has been removed.

dorks.title: Git config signatures on FOFA
dorks.description: Finds target-domain HTTP bodies containing the distinctive Git config marker.

dorks.title: Git config signatures on Shodan
dorks.description: Finds target-hosted pages serving Git configuration content in Shodan HTTP responses.

dorks.title: Git config signatures on Censys
dorks.description: Finds target web properties serving Git configuration markers in indexed HTTP bodies.

categories.title: Sensitive Files, Backups & Diagnostics
categories.description: Backup archives, database exports, logs, diagnostic output, deployment state, and source maps.

dorks.title: Backup and archive files
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:zip OR ext:tar OR ext:tgz OR ext:rar OR ext:7z) (inurl:backup OR inurl:archive OR inurl:old)
dorks.description: Finds compressed backups and old site archives that may contain source code, configuration, and customer data.

dorks.title: Editor and deployment backup files
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:bak OR ext:backup OR ext:old OR ext:orig OR ext:save OR ext:swp)
dorks.description: Finds backup copies left by editors and deployment processes, including obsolete credential-bearing configuration.

dorks.title: Database dump files
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:sql OR ext:dump OR ext:sqlite OR ext:db) ("MySQL dump" OR "PostgreSQL database dump" OR "CREATE TABLE")
dorks.description: Finds database exports with schema and row data, including credentials and PII.

dorks.title: Log files with sensitive markers
dorks.description: Finds indexed logs containing errors, credential markers, request data, or internal paths.

dorks.title: macOS Finder metadata
dorks.description: Finds .DS_Store files that disclose directory filenames and can guide discovery of unlinked sensitive content.

dorks.title: Apache server-status pages
dorks.description: Finds Apache status pages that can disclose active requests, client IPs, vhosts, and backend paths.

dorks.title: PHP diagnostic pages
dorks.description: Finds phpinfo output disclosing modules, environment variables, filesystem paths, and configuration.

dorks.title: Spring Boot environment actuator
dorks.description: Finds Spring Boot environment endpoints that may expose secrets, datasource passwords, and cloud credentials.

dorks.title: Java heap dumps
dorks.description: Finds Java heap dumps whose in-memory strings can contain sessions, credentials, and personal data.

dorks.title: YAML and properties secrets
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:yml OR ext:yaml OR ext:properties) ("password:" OR "secret:" OR "accessKey:")
dorks.description: Finds application configuration with password, secret, and access-key fields.

dorks.title: WordPress configuration backups
dorks.description: Finds backup copies of wp-config.php, which commonly contain database credentials and authentication keys.

dorks.title: Apache status titles on Shodan
dorks.description: Finds target-hosted Apache status pages using Shodan HTTP titles.

dorks.title: Backup files in urlscan
dorks.query: page.domain:{T} AND (filename:backup.zip OR filename:backup.sql OR filename:db.sql)
dorks.description: Finds archived target requests for common backup and database dump filenames.

dorks.title: Historical backup URLs
dorks.description: Finds archived URLs containing backup across target subdomains, including files no longer linked from the live site.

dorks.title: Rails credential key material
dorks.description: Finds Rails encrypted credentials and their master key; together they reveal application secrets.

dorks.title: Source-map references in page source
dorks.description: Finds target-related source-map references that may lead to original frontend source and embedded endpoints or secrets.

categories.title: PII & Sensitive Data Dumps
categories.description: Publicly indexed personal, employee, customer, patient, identity, and regulated records.

dorks.title: Customer and employee spreadsheets
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:xls OR ext:xlsx OR ext:csv) ("email" OR "phone" OR "address") ("customer" OR "employee" OR "members")
dorks.description: Finds spreadsheets with contact fields and customer, employee, or membership context that may contain bulk PII.

dorks.title: Social Security number records
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:csv OR ext:xls OR ext:xlsx OR ext:pdf) ("SSN" OR "Social Security Number")
dorks.description: Finds documents and datasets referencing US Social Security numbers, indicating highly sensitive regulated data.

dorks.title: Identity document exposure
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:pdf OR ext:jpg OR ext:png OR ext:docx) ("passport" OR "driver license" OR "national id")
dorks.description: Finds identity documents and scans that can expose names, photos, document numbers, and birth dates.

dorks.title: Patient and medical records
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:csv OR ext:xlsx OR ext:pdf) ("patient" OR "PHI" OR "medical record")
dorks.description: Finds medical datasets and documents that may contain protected health information.

dorks.title: Resumes with contact details
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:pdf OR ext:doc OR ext:docx) ("curriculum vitae" OR "resume") ("phone" OR "email")
dorks.description: Finds resumes and candidate records with personal contact and employment history data.

dorks.title: Confidential internal documents
dorks.query: site:{T} (ext:pdf OR ext:doc OR ext:docx) ("confidential" OR "internal use only" OR "do not distribute")
dorks.description: Finds documents explicitly marked confidential or internal, which may contain business-sensitive or personal data.

dorks.title: User-table SQL inserts
dorks.description: Finds SQL dump content inserting user records with email fields, a strong indicator of exposed account data.

dorks.title: PII fields in committed datasets
dorks.description: Finds target-related spreadsheets in public repositories with high-risk identity and birth-date fields.

dorks.title: Bulk target email lists
dorks.description: Finds text and spreadsheet files containing target-domain email addresses, useful for identifying bulk employee or customer exposure.

dorks.title: Target-domain identities in leak archives
dorks.description: Searches Intelligence X selectors for target-domain email identities across public web, document, and leak collections.

dorks.title: Sensitive Google Docs
dorks.description: Finds publicly shared Google Docs referencing the target and highly sensitive identity or payroll terms.

dorks.title: Spreadsheet downloads observed by urlscan
dorks.description: Finds target pages that delivered CSV or XLSX downloads for manual data-sensitivity review.

categories.title: Debug Output, Errors & Stack Traces
categories.description: Verbose framework errors, SQL diagnostics, stack traces, debug modes, and management metadata.

dorks.title: SQL database error messages
dorks.query: site:{T} ("You have an error in your SQL syntax" OR "SQLSTATE" OR "ODBC Driver")
dorks.description: Finds verbose SQL errors that can disclose query structure, schema names, drivers, and injection candidates.

dorks.title: PHP warnings and fatal errors
dorks.query: site:{T} ("Fatal error:" OR "Warning: mysql_" OR "Undefined index")
dorks.description: Finds PHP diagnostics that disclose filesystem paths, functions, and backend implementation details.

dorks.title: Python tracebacks
dorks.description: Finds Python stack traces revealing source paths, dependencies, function names, and unhandled input paths.

dorks.title: Java and Spring stack traces
dorks.description: Finds Java exception output with framework classes, package names, and backend call stacks.

dorks.title: ASP.NET detailed errors
dorks.description: Finds ASP.NET yellow-screen diagnostics that may disclose source lines, stack traces, and server paths.

dorks.title: Django debug mode output
dorks.query: site:{T} ("DisallowedHost" OR "You're seeing this error because you have DEBUG = True")

dorks.title: Laravel exception pages
dorks.query: site:{T} ("Whoops, looks like something went wrong" OR "Illuminate\Database\QueryException")

dorks.title: Rails exception output

dorks.title: Node.js unhandled errors

dorks.title: Spring Actuator management metadata

dorks.title: Python tracebacks on Shodan

dorks.title: Debug and Actuator requests in urlscan

dorks.title: Common redirect parameters
dorks.query: site:{T} (inurl:redirect= OR inurl:returnUrl= OR inurl:next= OR inurl:url=)
dorks.description: Finds parameterized navigation flows that may permit external redirects or unsafe URL handling.

dorks.title: OAuth and continuation redirect parameters
dorks.description: Finds OAuth and post-login continuation URLs where weak validation could enable code theft or phishing chains.

dorks.title: Remote URL fetch parameters
